mission: Standing research→probe→grill→ship→harvest loop over repo speed/quality/performance; terminates when two consecutive cycles' best probe-gated wins each fall under ~30s of full-sweep saving.

completionGate.statement: Not achieved until the stop rule fires (two consecutive sub-30s cycles) and the closing cycle's work ships as a PR driven to mergeable via /yeet, citing speed-loop.

agentLaunchers.command: /goal follow the loop protocol in goals/speed-loop/SPEC.md

phases.name: Further cycles until the stop rule fires

stopConditions: The stop rule fires: two consecutive cycles' best probe-gated candidates each under ~30s full-sweep saving.
The loop's own research cost exceeds its measured wins for a full cycle.
A cycle would ship a new always-on quality gate without a cost-vs-catch case.
